## Database Design

%%| label: fig-erd-schema

    us_counties {
        int county_id PK
        string county_name
        string state
        string state_fips_code
        string county_fips_code
        string county_ns_code
        string fips_class_code
        string functional_status
        float centroid_lat
        float centroid_lon
        float land_area_sqmi
        float water_area_sqmi
    }

    population {
        int year PK
        int county_id PK, FK
        int population
    }

    personal_income {
        int year PK
        int county_id PK, FK
        string industry_classification
        float per_capita_personal_income_dollars
        float personal_income_thousands_of_dollars
    }

    gdp {
        int year PK
        int county_id PK, FK
        float real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands
        float current_gdp_dollars_thousands
        float quantity_index_gdp
    }

    res_construction_permits {
        int year PK
        int county_id PK, FK
        int all_permits
        int single_family_permits
        int all_multifamily_permits
        int multifamily_permits_2_units
        int multifamily_permits_3_4_units
        int multifamily_permits_5_or_more_units
    }

    unemployment {
        int year PK
        int county_id PK, FK
        int civilian_labor_force
        int employed
        int unemployed
        float unemployment_rate
    }

    air_quality {
        int year PK
        int county_id PK, FK
        float pm25_max_sd
        float pm25_med_sd
        float pm25_mean_sd
        float pm25_pop_sd
        float pm25_max_daily_avg
        float pm25_med_daily_avg
        float pm25_mean_daily_avg
        float pm25_pop_daily_avg
    }

    naics_518_establishments {
        int county_id PK
        int year
        int estabs
    }

    business_patterns {
        int year PK
        string naics_industry_code PK
        int county_id PK, FK
        int tot_employee_count
        float annual_payroll
        int tot_establishment_count
        int est_lt_5
        int est5_9
        int est10_19
        int est20_49
        int est50_99
        int est100_249
        int est250_499
        int est500_999
        int est_gt_1000
        int est1000_1500
        int est1500_2500
        int est2500_5000
        int est_gt_5000
    }

    naics_code_look_up {
        string sector PK
        string definition
    }

    county_distances_lookup {
        int county_id_2 PK, FK
        int county_id PK, FK
        float centroid_lon
        float centroid_lat
        float centroid_lon_2
        float centroid_long_2
        float distance_miles
    }

    naics_518_nearby_estabs_50mi {

        float nearby_estabs_50mi_per_sqmi
        float nearby_estabs_50mi_per_100_sqmi
    }
